domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers fundamental IT architectures, technologies, and industry standards that underpin modern VMware networking environments, ensuring candidates understand the core principles required to support virtualized infrastructure and enterprise network deployments effectively.

This domain focuses on core components and features of the VMware solution suite within a virtualized infrastructure, requiring candidates to demonstrate knowledge of how these specific elements integrate to provide scalable networking capabilities for enterprise systems.

This domain addresses planning and design phases required to implement effective VMware networking solutions, focusing on how to translate business requirements into functional, high-performance network designs that align with established VMware best practices for virtualized environments.

This domain covers practical tasks of installing, configuring, and administrating VMware networking components and services, ensuring that candidates can successfully deploy and maintain the infrastructure according to the technical specifications provided in the official documentation.

This domain focuses on identifying, diagnosing, and resolving issues to optimize performance of the VMware solution, requiring candidates to apply systematic troubleshooting methodologies to maintain system health and ensure consistent network availability for all users.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive prepared for a 135-minute exam session. Manage your time effectively across the 70 questions to ensure all sections are addressed. Stay focused on the technical requirements and configuration steps outlined in the exam objectives to achieve the passing score of 300.

faq.answer_text: The VCP-NV certification exam consists of exactly 70 questions. Candidates should manage their time carefully throughout the session to ensure they have sufficient opportunity to review and answer every question presented during the testing period.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: The passing score for this professional certification exam is 300. This score is measured on a standardized scale of 100-500, which is used to determine whether a candidate has met the required proficiency level for the certification.

The exam has a total duration of 135 minutes. This time limit is designed to allow candidates to complete all 70 questions while demonstrating their technical knowledge and practical skills regarding VMware networking solutions and infrastructure management.

The price for the VCP-NV certification exam is $250. Candidates should verify this cost through the official VMware (Broadcom) portal before scheduling their appointment to ensure they have the most current pricing information available for their region.
faq.question_title: What is the cost of the exam?

methodology.summary: This page was built by synthesizing official VMware (Broadcom) exam documentation and verified certification facts to provide a clear and accurate overview of the VCP-NV requirements for all prospective candidates seeking professional validation.

editorial.overview: The VCP-NV certification, managed by VMware (Broadcom), validates technical proficiency in VMware networking solutions. This exam assesses skills across five domains, ranging from IT architectures and standards to the planning, design, installation, administration, and troubleshooting of VMware solutions. It is a professional-level credential for individuals working with virtualized network environments who must demonstrate competence in maintaining infrastructure systems to meet organizational requirements and industry standards. The certification remains valid for 2 years, after which a renewal is required.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official VMware (Broadcom) exam guide to understand the scope of the five domains. Practice installing and configuring VMware solutions in a lab environment to gain hands-on experience. Focus on the specific workflows for managing transport nodes, gateways, and security policies. Utilize official documentation to master the technical requirements for each domain before attempting the 70-question exam. Ensure you are familiar with all core concepts to succeed in the testing environment.
editorial.who_should_take: This exam is intended for IT professionals and network administrators who manage VMware networking environments. Candidates should have practical experience in deploying, configuring, and maintaining VMware solutions to ensure network performance and security in production environments.

exam_format: Multiple Choice (VCP/VCAP Design); Hands-on Lab (VCAP Deploy); Panel Defense (VCDX)
exam_rules: Closed-book exam for VCP and VCAP written/design exams. No notes, study materials, or electronic devices permitted. Personal items must be stored. No food or drink. VCAP Deploy lab exams are hands-on in a live vSphere environment — no closed-book restriction applies to the lab interface. VCDX panel defense requires submitting a design documentation package in advance.
id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID required. ID must match the name on the exam registration. Acceptable forms include passport, driver's license, or national ID card.

renewal_options: All VMware certifications are valid for 2 years. Renewal requires passing the current version of the exam or a higher-level exam in the same track before expiry. No CE credit option — exam retake is the only renewal path.

retake_policy.notes: 15-day waiting period between retake attempts for VCP and VCAP written/design exams. VCAP lab and VCDX panel defense retake scheduling is coordinated with VMware/Broadcom directly.

testing_centers.notes: VCP and VCAP written/design exams via Pearson VUE test centers or OnVUE online proctoring
